architectural-decision-records.why: records the presence-gate decision and why it is separate from parity
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0045: a presence gate for the three genesis skeleton files, its exit-code contract, fail-closed, and the presence-is-not-integrity limit
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

verifiable-quality-gates.why: the gate ships a discrimination test proven to fail when neutralized
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added check-bootstrap-presence.mjs and a 7-case fixture test; confirmed 5 of 7 cases go red when the gate is forced never to report a missing file
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the change adds executable code (.mjs), so the test level is explicit
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: a fixture-driven test building repos with and without each skeleton file is the right level for a presence check; no integration/e2e surface
quotes: Fast, isolated tests for logic; a smaller number of integration tests for the seams

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the added .mjs; the behavior is already committed as Gherkin
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: implements the check-bootstrap-presence gate the genesis presence-check scenario assumes, with a discrimination test
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR states the limit rather than overclaiming
skeptical-audit.what: documented that presence is not integrity: the gate proves the three files exist, not that branch protection wires the aggregator or that the manifest is faithful
quotes: content hash, a query, a version/commit SHA, or a URL + retrieval date;

judge-arch.why: reviewed in fresh context before the PR
judge-arch.what: will run a fresh-context judge-arch review over the presence gate, its test, and the ADR before opening the PR
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: a presence check that reads no content and runs nothing; no input, auth, or data surface

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: a CI verification script; no system, data, or resilience architecture change

pattern-selector.why: no design pattern selected; a straightforward existence check

sre-operational-readiness.why: no service, SLI/SLO, or alerting change

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or schema/data migration

arch-encode.why: planned enforcement machinery, not a rule encoded from a newly-caught mistake
